evaluation.bip39: Lowercase unfiltered lexical words; punctuation boundaries; invalid decoded group ␞ is a hard region boundary. Do not select only dictionary words.
evaluation.hex: Boundary-delimited 64hex scalars and SEC public keys.
evaluation.candidatePrivacy: Hold raw streams private until review; publish only safe domain-separated fingerprints for valid private records. A valid record is a lead, not an authenticated prize.

Direction and parity variants are one procedure, not independent theories.

tests.title: Visible capitalization as a data carrier

parameters.bip39Tokenization: lowercase unfiltered lexical tokens; ordinary punctuation boundaries; invalid-group ␞ is a hard region boundary
parameters.hexMatching: 64hex scalar and SEC records require non-hex boundaries
parameters.bitCarrier: case of first alphabetic character in the first lexical word of each printed row
parameters.nonAlphabeticFirstWord: barrier at original bit position; never drop

controls: synthetic ASCII and Bacon case carriers
invalid groups and unpadded trailing bits
tests.negativeCriterion: No valid declared literal record excludes only this exact extraction, source population and record-format scope; it does not exclude another cipher, format or selector.
limitations: Grammar, ordinary capitalization and the all-caps paragraph are strong null explanations.
This uses visible case, not unreliable DOCM bold labels.
A positive requires source-crop verification of the precise case choices.
